mapper.sql: id, task_id, task_key, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, run_id, from_sequence, to_sequence, expected_memory_version, base_context_revision, coverage_hash, policy_version, status, attempt_count, lease_owner, lease_until, fencing_token, error_message, trace_id, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM context_compaction_task WHERE task_key = #{taskKey} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM context_compaction_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM context_compaction_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0
AND (tenant_id IS NULL OR tenant_id = '')
AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE context_compaction_task SET status = 'processing', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_owner = CONCAT('mysql-', CONNECTION_ID()), lease_until = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 60 SECOND), fencing_token = fencing_token + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND (status IN ('pending', 'retrying') OR (status = 'processing' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) AND deleted = 0
UPDATE context_compaction_task SET status = 'succeeded', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'processing' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE context_compaction_task SET status = 'retrying', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'processing' AND deleted = 0

UPDATE context_compaction_task SET status = 'dead', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('processing', 'retrying', 'pending') AND deleted = 0
